title: searchAdgroupList
label: LAZADA · API REFERENCE
subtitle: Search adgroup with bizCode by seller.
html:
Request Address

GET/POST/sponsor/solutions/adgroup/searchAdgroupList
RegionBase URL
Vietnamhttps://api.lazada.vn/rest
Singaporehttps://api.lazada.sg/rest
Philippineshttps://api.lazada.com.ph/rest
Malaysiahttps://api.lazada.com.my/rest
Thailandhttps://api.lazada.co.th/rest
Indonesiahttps://api.lazada.co.id/rest

Common Request Parameters

NameTypeRequiredDescription
app_keyStringYesUnique app ID issued by LAZADA Open Platform console when you apply for an app category
timestampStringYesThe time stamp of the request e.g. 1517820392000 (which translates to 5 February 2018 08:46:32) with less than 7200s difference from UTC time
access_tokenStringYesAPI interface call credentials
sign_methodStringYesThe HMAC hash algorithm you are using to calculate your signature
signStringYesPart of the authentication process that is used for identifying and verifying who is sending a request (click <a target='_blank' href='https://open.lazada.com/apps/doc/doc?nodeId=10450&docId=108068'>here</a> for details)

Request Parameters

NameTypeRequiredDescription
pageSizeNumberYesPage size.
endDateStringYesCampaign end date.
campaignIdNumberYesCampaign id.
pageNoNumberYesPage number.
bizCodeStringYesDecided to choose which advertisement solution.SD:sponsoredSearch.
adgroupNameStringNoAdgroup name for fuzzy search.
startDateStringYesCampaign start date.
onlineStatusNumberNoThe campaign online status.1:Online;0:Offline;9:deleted.

Response Parameters

NameTypeRequiredDescription
successBooleanYesThe detail result, for this api is boolean.
errorMsgStringYesIf the api call failed, this field will show the detail reason.
analyseTraceIdStringYesIf the api call failed, you could find us with this.If the api call failed, you could find us with this.
totalCountNumberNoThe count of adgorup.
resultObject[]NoThe detail result, for this api is adgroup detail list.
  adgroupIdNumberNoAdgroup id.
  adgroupNameStringNoThe adgroup name, normanlly is the product name.
  imageUrlStringNoNormally is the product first pic.
  bidPriceStringNoThis is the maximum bid price that you have set for your campaign.Local currency.
  autoCreativeNumberNoAutomated Creatives selection allows Lazada to automatically optimise towards the best performing creative from your existing product image set.1:ON;0:OFF.
  audienceViewDTOListObject[]NoThis setting allows you to bid higher on premium audiences that are more likely to convert in your store.
    adCrowdTagNumberNo1:on store visitors in the past 15 days;2:on in-market audiences for similar products;3:Store Awareness Audience;4:Store Interest Audience
    discountNumberNoThe discount you want to give.eg:10 means 10% discount.
  spendStringNoSpend is the total amount of your spend.
  impressionsStringNoAn impression is counted each time your promoted product is shown. Impressions help you understand how often your product is being seen.
  clicksStringNoA click is counted each time someone clicks on your promoted product.
  ctrStringNoClickthrough rate (CTR) is the ratio showing how often people who see your promoted product end up clicking on it. It’s calculated as Clicks divided by Impressions.
  cpcStringNoThe cost-per-click (CPC) is the average amount you pay each time someone clicks your promoted product. It’s calculated as Spend divided by Clicks.
  storeUnitsSoldStringNoThe total number of units sold after the shoppers click on your promoted product during the selected date range.
  storeRevenueStringNoTotal store revenue is generated from the units sold in your store after buyer(s) click your promoted product(s). It is the total amount paid by the buyer plus all discounts applied, store credit, shipping fees, and surcharges.
  storeRoiStringNoThe store's return on investment (ROI) shows how efficient your Sponsored Discovery's spend is in driving revenue for your store.
  storeOrdersStringNoThe total number of orders from your store during the selected time period, after someone clicks on your promoted product.
  productOrdersStringNoThe total number of direct orders from your store during the selected time period, after someone clicks on your promoted product.
  unitsSoldStringNoThe number of promoted product units sold after shoppers click on them and purchase them.
  revenueStringNoRevenue generated from your promoted product after someone clicks on it and purchases it. It is the total buyer paid amount inclusive of all discounts applied, store credit, shipping fees and surcharges.
  statusNumberNoThe combine of balance,budget,schedule...
  adAccountBalanceStatusNumberNoIs the balance enough.1:ON;0:OFF.
  adApproveStatusNumberNoIs the adgroup be approved.1:ON;0:OFF.
  adSwitchStatusNumberNoIs the adgroup on right now.1:ON;0:OFF.
  campaignDailyBudgetStatusNumberNoIs the campaign budget of today enougn now.1:ON;0:OFF.
  campaignScheduleStatusNumberNoIs the campaign running now.1:ON;0:OFF.
  campaignSwitchStatusNumberNoIs the campaign switch on now.1:ON;0:OFF.
  productEligibleStatusNumberNoIs the product eligible.1:ON;0:OFF.
  productStockStatusNumberNoIs the product have enougn stock.1:ON;0:OFF.
  sellerEligibleStatusNumberNoIs the seller eligible.1:ON;0:OFF.
  itemIdNumberNoProduct id.
